sections.description: Keeps the site's Google Business Profile reviews as WordPress posts, filtered and formatted, so an Elementor loop can show them in any design. A scheduled CGN job sends the reviews.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Reviews post type that holds the site's Google reviews, synced by CGN's scheduled job through a secure REST endpoint.
  • Rules on Reviews → Settings: minimum rating, text required, how many to show, newest first. Reviews that don't qualify stay as drafts.
  • Reviewer names as "First L." by default, review dates in a chosen format, and the owner's reply with a label.
  • Every field works with Elementor's Post Custom Field dynamic tag, plus a [cgn_review] shortcode for the reply.
